---
name: Research investigation
about: Define a reproducible investigation or experiment
title: '[Research] '
---

## Question and hypothesis
State the research question, hypothesis and alternative explanations.

## Evidence and methods
Identify sources, data provenance, versions, controls, evaluation methods and limitations.

## Acceptance criteria
Define measurable outputs and reproducibility requirements before analysis.

## Results and interpretation
Record actual results, including negative or inconclusive findings. Distinguish observations from hypotheses.

## Reproduction and follow-up
Link scripts, evidence, artifacts and next investigations. Do not include restricted data or credentials.
